_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score coiled near Panic/Denial with neutral 30d momentum, neutral funding, and 3% base rate of ±2 moves; no breaker (ETF reclaim or fear-flush) is confirmed.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD in Denial; narrative silent on phase/direction but risk-off metals tape does not contradict
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC remains rangebound, funding near 0.01%, fear_greed mid-20s, score stays inside Denial band
next_move.invalidated_if: Impulsive break with 30d momentum leaving neutral and funding negative as fear_greed hits teens (down to Panic), or ETF flows flip positive and fear_greed reclaims 40s (up to Anxiety)
